name: FOLFOX-4 (de Gramont)

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic FOLFOX (fluorouracil/leucovorin/oxaliplatin) backbone is not biomarker-restricted. RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested (broad multigene NGS panel also picks up POLE/POLD1, RET, NTRK) to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons, not the backbone itself: anti-EGFR (cetuximab or panitumumab) requires KRAS/NRAS/BRAF wild-type with a left-sided primary; HER2-directed therapy for HER2 amplified; checkpoint inhibitors for dMMR/MSI-H; encorafenib for BRAF V600E. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN, licensed), Colon Cancer Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B) and Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D).

lineOfTherapy: first-line, and an option in subsequent lines for metastatic disease (e.g., after prior irinotecan); not line-scoped when used as adjuvant or neoadjuvant therapy

eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function
eligibilityCriteria.source: DeVita, Cancer PPO 12th ed., Table 40.13 footnote

drugs.name: OXALIplatin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123714. 85 mg/m2 IV over 2 hr, day 1 only.

drugs.name: Leucovorin
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123715. 200 mg/m2 IV, days 1 and 2.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (bolus)
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123716. 400 mg/m2 IV bolus, days 1 and 2, given after leucovorin/oxaliplatin.

drugs.name: Fluorouracil (continuous infusion)
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 123716. 600 mg/m2 IV over 22 hr, days 1 and 2, given after the bolus.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: give before chemotherapy per NCCN Antiemesis appendix D moderate-emetic-risk tier (oxaliplatin-based regimen)

supportiveCare: antiemetics: moderate emetogenic risk tier (NCCN appendix D) - prophylaxis required on day of treatment
G-CSF: not routinely indicated - FOLFOX-4 is not on the NCCN high-risk febrile-neutropenia list; assess intermediate-risk factors per appendix C, physician-patient discussion

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle - platinum agent
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle - oxaliplatin

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Protocol-specific delay/reduce criteria may apply; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

guideline.locator: Colon Cancer, Principles of Adjuvant Therapy and Chemotherapy Regimens (COL-G; Modified FOLFOX6 is the printed adjuvant FOLFOX template); Principles of Systemic Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Disease (COL-D; FOLFOX initial and subsequent therapy); Principles of Risk Assessment for Stage II Disease (COL-F); Principles of Pathologic and Molecular Review (COL-B)

sources.name: DeVita 12th ed. (core)
sources.value: FOLFOX-4 (de Gramont) was the pivotal MOSAIC adjuvant regimen

sources.name: Standard Guidelines (NCCN, licensed) Colon Cancer
sources.value: Modified FOLFOX6 is the printed adjuvant chemotherapy regimen; treatment algorithms cite FOLFOX generically

divergence.note: Both sources place FOLFOX in the adjuvant and metastatic settings, so treatmentSetting is not in conflict. They differ on the specific adjuvant FOLFOX variant printed as the template (FOLFOX-4 historically per DeVita/MOSAIC versus Modified FOLFOX6 in the current guideline). Physician-facing regimen identity kept as authored (FOLFOX-4); adjuvant variant selection left to clinical review.

provenanceNote: Earlier VERIFY-resolution (DeVita core): histology resolved to adenocarcinoma per DeVita 12th ed. Chapter 40 (line 121516, colorectal adenocarcinoma; Histologic Type section line 121080); eligibilityCriteria resolved to good performance status with normal renal, hepatic, and bone marrow function per DeVita Table 40.13 footnote (line 123747) and the metastatic-disease entry-criteria preamble (lines 123415 to 123420). DeVita establishes FOLFOX-4 in both the adjuvant setting (the pivotal MOSAIC adjuvant study used FOLFOX-4, line 122908) and the metastatic regimen table (Table 40.13). ONCQIS Wave-1 batch 1 guideline resolution (Standard Guidelines, NCCN licensed, Colon Cancer v2.2026): treatmentSetting resolved to neoadjuvant, adjuvant, and metastatic (FOLFOX is a printed adjuvant chemotherapy regimen on COL-G, initial and subsequent systemic therapy for advanced/metastatic disease on COL-D, and a preferred neoadjuvant option for bulky/locally advanced and resectable synchronous metastatic disease). stage resolved to high-risk II, III, and IV (adjuvant FOLFOX is superior to fluorouracil/leucovorin for stage III and reasonable for high-risk stage II per COL-G and COL-F; stage IV is the advanced/metastatic setting per COL-D). lineOfTherapy resolved to first-line with a subsequent-line option in metastatic disease (COL-D). biomarkers resolved: the cytotoxic FOLFOX backbone is not biomarker-restricted, while RAS (KRAS, NRAS), BRAF V600E, HER2 (ERBB2), and MMR or MSI status are tested to guide targeted or immunotherapy add-ons (COL-B and COL-D). A divergence is recorded because the guideline prints Modified FOLFOX6 (not FOLFOX-4) as the adjuvant FOLFOX template; the settings themselves do not conflict. No field remains VERIFY. evidence.core evidenceStatus left unknown. No hospital or endorsement claim.
